newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 3.

text.p: All major Mexican ports were open as of 1000 local/1600 GMT Friday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
The ministry updated port and shipping conditions for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Cloudy skies and light rains along the coasts of Nayarit, Jalisco, Colima, Michoacan, Guerrero and Chiapas states and in the northwest of the country, with northeast winds at up to 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour). Winds along the Baja California peninsula and in Sonora from the north and northwest reported at the same velocity.

A new cold front from the southwest United States will affect the northern region and the Baja California peninsula in 24 hours with lower temperatures, light rains and winds from the north at 10 to 20 knots (19 to 39 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) with waves four to six feet high.
Clear skies along the northeast Gulf of Mexico, except along the Yucatan peninsula, which reported light rains and south and southeast winds at 10 to 15 knots with waves of three to five feet.
Light rains and clouds along the coast of Quintana Roo and Central America, with dominant winds from the east at 10 to 15 knots and waves of three to five feet.
